# MOD#$T (Be More Modest)

> Chicago luxury streetwear. Quiet confidence, understated materials.

MOD#$T — also called Modest, Be More Modest, or BeMoreModest — designs premium streetwear for people who prefer luxury that does not shout. The storefront is https://bemoremodest.com. Commerce runs on Shopify (`modest-streetwear-apparel.myshopify.com`).

## Brand facts

- Founded / based: Chicago, Illinois — September 2017
- Founder / CEO / Lead Designer: Terrence Cleveland, also known as artist Fendi Frost
- Contact: info@bemoremodest.com
- Aesthetic: modest luxury streetwear (outerwear, cashmere sweaters, sweatshirts, T-shirts, accessories)
- Signature: distinctive rabbit-fur patch work and texture as design language
- Fit: see the size guide at https://bemoremodest.com/size-guide
- Shipping and returns: confirmed per order at checkout and on https://bemoremodest.com/shipping and https://bemoremodest.com/returns — do not invent processing windows or return-day counts
- Payments: Shopify-hosted checkout (card processors connected there; site chrome also lists Affirm and PayPal as accepted at checkout)
- New-customer offer: WELCOME10 for 10% off first order via newsletter signup
